blurb: Town Hall Lanes offers a modern 10-lane bowling alley with a retro-50’s design and AMF synthetic lanes oiled daily. They provide a broad menu of pub fare anchored by house-made flatbreads and half-pound burgers, plus a variety of craft beers and cocktails. Leagues run seasonally with open bowling hours daily.
